Subject: Request to reschedule Thursday’s call

Hi [Client Name],

I need to cancel our call scheduled for Thursday. I apologize for the short notice. Would you be available to reschedule to [Option 1: date/time] or [Option 2: date/time]? If those don’t work, please let me know times that suit you and I’ll do my best to accommodate.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
